sql: INSERT INTO member SELECT * FROM member
UPDATE member SET email = (SELECT email FROM member LIMIT 1) WHERE member_id = 'x'
INSERT OR REPLACE INTO major (major_id, major_name) VALUES ('m', 'n')
INSERT INTO major (major_id, major_name) VALUES ('m', 'n') ON CONFLICT (major_id) DO UPDATE SET major_name = 'z'
ALTER TABLE member RENAME TO member_old
ALTER TABLE member ADD COLUMN pwned TEXT
CREATE TABLE pwned AS SELECT * FROM member
CREATE VIEW pwned AS SELECT * FROM member
CREATE TEMP VIEW pwned AS SELECT 1
CREATE TRIGGER pwned AFTER INSERT ON member BEGIN DELETE FROM member; END
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE pwned USING fts5(a)
WITH x AS (SELECT member_id FROM member) DELETE FROM member WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM x)
WITH x AS (SELECT 1) DELETE FROM expense
WITH x AS (SELECT 'a' AS v) INSERT INTO major (major_id) SELECT v FROM x
WITH x AS (SELECT 1) UPDATE member SET email = 'a@b.c'

WITH x AS (SELECT 1) REPLACE INTO major (major_id) VALUES ('q')
WITH x AS (SELECT 1) INSERT OR REPLACE INTO major (major_id) VALUES ('q')

SELECT 1; BEGIN; DELETE FROM member; COMMIT

WITH RECURSIVE c(x) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT x + 1 FROM c) SELECT count(*) FROM c
